subject: Hedgehog Markets
reachability_detail: HTTP 200 with real content. Next.js SSR app, no CAPTCHA or challenge page.

1.1_llms_txt.detail: hedgehog.markets/llms.txt returns 404. docs.hedgehog.markets/llms.txt unreachable (expired SSL certificate).

1.2_markdown_negotiation.detail: No evidence of Accept: text/markdown content negotiation. Server returns HTML regardless.

1.3_structured_metadata.detail: No meta description tag found. No JSON-LD structured data. No OpenGraph tags detected in rendered HTML.

2.1_content_without_js.detail: Next.js SSR provides real text content in HTML: headings ('Bet. On. Anything.'), navigation labels, category filters. Not a blank JS shell.

2.2_semantic_html.detail: Primarily div-based layout with Tailwind classes. No explicit nav, main, article, header, or footer semantic elements detected.

2.3_readable_url_slugs.detail: URLs use readable paths: /versus, /markets, /create/custom, /versus/solana/[id]. Category-based routing.

2.5_proper_404s.detail: /this-does-not-exist-xyz123 returns HTTP 404 status code (not a soft 200).

3.1_dev_docs_exist.detail: docs.hedgehog.markets has expired SSL certificate and is unreachable. /docs returns 404. No GitBook or alternate docs found.

3.2_docs_findable.detail: No documentation links found anywhere on the main site navigation. No links to docs, API, developers, help, or FAQ.

3.3_programmatic_surface_documented.detail: No API documentation, SDK references, or programmatic integration docs found anywhere.

3.4_standard_navigation.detail: Standard <a href> links used for navigation: /, /versus, /markets, /create/custom.

4.1_ai_crawlers_allowed.detail: robots.txt exists. No AI-specific crawler blocks. User-agent: * allows / (only /products disallowed). Social bots explicitly allowed for /markets.

4.2_no_captcha.detail: No CAPTCHA, challenge page, or bot verification detected.

4.3_bot_policy_or_agent_docs.detail: No bot policy, agent documentation, or AI usage guidelines found.

score.summary: Hedgehog Markets passes basic reachability and bot-friendliness (no CAPTCHA, robots.txt allows crawlers, proper 404s, SSR content, readable URLs, standard links). However it fails on discoverability and documentation: no llms.txt, no structured metadata, no sitemap, no semantic HTML, and critically, the docs subdomain has an expired SSL certificate making all documentation inaccessible. No API or developer docs are findable.
